notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market SaaS: product discovery/search for a commerce verticalized marketplace. ~250 engineers, PM-led relevance team.
- Primary objective: replace brittle rules + Elastic boosting with a learned reranker. Target: measurable lift in MRR/nDCG while keeping cost within band.

Reranking/POC scope (customer asks):
- Run 6-week POC. Two phases: (1) Hosted API integration for rapid experiments (rerank endpoint, test vectors, dev evals); (2) If quality & perf good, move to Dedicated reserved pool for production traffic.
- Offline eval set: they will provide ~40k queries with click labels. Want Redwood to run offline scoring (batch) and provide MRR / nDCG@5 / Precision@1 reports.
- Latency/throughput targets: aim for median rerank latency <80ms for top-10 on Dedicated; acceptable p95 up to 250ms during peaks. Throughput target: 50-100 qps for peak daytime.
- Model preferences: open to mid-size LLM reranker (quantized variant) + embedding cache for candidates. Want fallback policy to smaller model variant when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Cost sensitivity: finite budget for POC + low double-digit k/year if move to Dedicated. Quote requested for reserved pool + burst capacity. Customer quote: "can’t materially exceed $8k/mo for initial phase".

Security & compliance:
- Needs SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs, and a data residency clause for EU users. Security questionnaire submitted; security answers doc in Drive.
- Preference: start on Hosted API for POC to reduce lead time, but require VPC/Dedicated for production.

Competitive context / differentiation checks:
- Currently using Elastic + simple Lambda reranker. Their in-house baseline scores ~nDCG@5 = 0.42; target +5-10% lift. Interested in Redwood’s rerank tuning helpers and offline eval tooling.

POC success metrics / acceptance criteria:
- Offline: MRR and nDCG@5 improvement vs baseline on held-out eval set.
- Online (pilot): click-through lift or downstream conversion lift tracked over 2-week pilot.
- Operational: sustained p95 latency <= 250ms and predictable cost per 1M queries.

Action items / next steps (notes from 2026-02-12 demo):
- Marcus to share Dedicated pricing + burst options (by 2026-02-18).
- AE to draft SOW for 6-week POC (scope + deliverables + acceptance).
- Customer to deliver final eval set and baseline exports (ETA 2026-02-20).
- Security to review KMS/residency text; legal to draft SLA tweaks.

Callouts / quotes:
- Customer PM: "We want parity/superiority to our Elastic baseline before committing to Dedicated."
- Eng lead: "Important that offline scoring is straightforward — we need a batch API to score 40k queries overnight."

Sticking points / blockers:
- Legal wording for data residency and vendor SLA.
- Budget for Dedicated reserve; finance needs final ARR estimate and committed term.
- Need Elastic export sanity checks before we can run parity evals.
notes_summary: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Redwood rerank endpoints. 6-week POC planned: hosted integration -> dedicated if results meet MRR/nDCG uplift and latency targets. Security SSO/KMS and data residency are blockers; pricing sensitivity around $8k/mo for initial phase.
